Use case: ui-mockup. Create realistic, production-quality UI design for the Incan.io programming language homepage, 1440 pixels wide by 1800 pixels tall, naturally scrollable desktop composition, no browser/device chrome. Single idea only. Clear hierarchy, strong typography, original imagery and purposeful spacing. Welcome a newcomer to a serious, characterful language: understand what it is, see its code, begin learning. A functional language home, not a sales page or registry.

ATTACHED SOURCE IMAGES (in order): Oven Alpha live screenshot for Incan atmosphere, official cube LOGO, official gold WORDMARK, ORIGINAL adult Incus observer portrait, original Oven scene. Use both the official LOGO and WORDMARK together in the masthead. Preserve supplied Incus portrait recognizably intact, especially his face, dark hair, cyan visor, brass armor, adult proportions. NEVER redraw/reimagine Incus into a cartoon, chibi, toy or a new species. Actual original artwork is a deliberate supporting visual, not a dominant giant mascot. The Oven scene may be a small contextual image lower down; never turn it into a full-width cinematic homepage hero. Learn Oven's coherent brand world without cloning its dense technical content.

Shared design system: near-black graphite/deep teal surfaces, warm antique-gold serif headings and rules, controlled cyan details, subtle material texture. Brawler-like headings and Exo 2-like clear readable body, legible monospaced source with accurate syntax highlighting. Calm and richly crafted with genuine Incan personality. Body 16–18px, comfortable lines <=65 characters, headline about 54–64px, code about17px. Separation through space, grouping, alignment and typography first; fine dividers next; subtle tint then borders; shadows last. A source/terminal panel can have a frame as a meaningful object; no cards inside cards or boxed sections everywhere.

Avoid: package catalog/ivory .pub style, generic SaaS feature grid, sales pitch/slogans, fake corporate proof, huge typography or blank spaces, huge scenic advertising art, mascot stickers, sci-fi HUD, disconnected ornaments, fake editor/playground interactions, hidden essential content in tabs, fake dates/adoption metrics. Focus the first viewport on one clear primary learning action and a useful example, with supporting content continuing naturally below. Original actual cube and adult Incus matter; do not substitute lookalikes.

H1: Welcome to Incan.
Lead: A statically typed programming language with readable source and native compilation.
Actions: Get started / Explore the language.

Example title: hello.incn
model User:
    name: str

def greet_user(user: User) -> str:
    return f"Hello, {user.name}!"

def main() -> None:
    user = User(name="Incan")
    println(greet_user(user))
Caption: Named data. Typed functions. Clear structure.

cd hello
incan oven bake --project .
incan run
incan test
incan build --release
